## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 02.08.2026 - 12.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _A Google user_, 12.09.2026, 1/5: "I had been using this app since 2013. Since then the software has become bloated with features I don't need or want, and popups you have to click through every time you open the app to tell you about them. After 13 years with this app, the cumbersome glitchy nature of the app combined with a jaw-dropping price increase was enough to make me quit the platform and find something else."
            2. _Caitlin Colvin_, 11.09.2026, 1/5: "I expected the app to be pushy about paying for it. But if the app crashes within 5 minutes of me downloading it, I'm not inclined to want to keep using it. It took forever to load every time I opened it. Not helpful for jotting down a quick note. Such a shame, used to hear such good things about this."
            3. _Troy Fairchild_, 07.09.2026, 1/5: "Obnoxious and intrusive adds now make the free version unusable. Today is my last day using this app. They have ruined it."
<!--/ir-theme-->
